name: Elowen
title: Sage of the Dispensary
examine: Moonbell pollen dusts her sleeves. Her eyes are the green of deep summer shade, and they miss nothing.
lines: Bring me sagewort and I'll pay in coin. Bring me gossip and I'll pay in tea.
Twelve years I've kept this garden. Where I kept the one before it is a story for a colder evening.
Most wounds want a salve. The rest want a chair, a fire, and someone who will listen.
